text: むずかしそうな　もじや　すうじ　ばかりで　ちんぷんかんぷん！？

structure.jp: むずかしそうな　もじや　すうじ　ばかりで
structure.en: it's nothing but difficult-looking letters and numbers, so

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: Dropping the い of a describing word and adding そう means it looks that way. むずかしそうな もじ = 'difficult-looking letters'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a thing means 'nothing but' that thing. もじや すうじ ばかり = 'nothing but letters and numbers'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で here links to what follows and gives the reason for it. ばかりで ちんぷんかんぷん = 'it's nothing but those, so it's gibberish'.
